race.comment: NINJITZOU (3) is worth following up after scoring at the Sunny Coast, where he raced handy and fought off his rivals. His previous fourth in a CL2 at this track was sound enough, and the return to this distance range is backed by a prior win around the trip. Fitter and can make it two on the bounce. SAVEUR (14) is the main danger, dropping to an easier meeting after being held up at Doomben when favourite, with her Eagle Farm third two back tying in strongly. ANCESTRAL (13) also comes through metro BM68 form, having worked home for second at Doomben, though she has to turn around an Eagle Farm line with SAVEUR. TRANSGRESS (8) deserves respect after demolishing his rivals on the Gold Coast Poly last time. Expect him to bounce straight to the front again and give them something to catch.
